title: Proposed Teach capability name/type entry overlay
description: Additive, review-only constraints. Not installed in the live kernel. No generic existing kind is reinterpreted. Exact candidate entries are also pinned with const; future status changes require a successor admitted schema, not weakening this proposal.

const.definition: A typed, dot-delimited action constant.
const.lifecycle_note: No independent business lifecycle. Registry candidate/approved status is governance metadata, not a product lifecycle.
authority_implications: A constant identifies an action; possession or registration of the constant does not grant permission.
C14 alone defines the action meaning, assignment, scope, evaluation and denial semantics.
An unregistered or unauthorized protected operation fails closed.
This candidate cannot authorize active-contract or merged-implementation use.

const.definition: The canonical string identifier of a Capability action constant, using the exact C14 capability vocabulary.
const.identifier_note: This record defines an identifier type. Its own registry identity is id=CapabilityId; it does not have a second independently allocated business identifier.
authority_implications: A valid identifier string is not a capability grant.
C01 owns naming; C14 owns authorization semantics.
Unknown names fail closed.
The existing candidate status is unchanged.
